Gateway

                         Offline                    
          

AdGuard Home, Traefik, Cloudflare Tunnel, WireGuard, Authelia

          

          This stack provides a secure and efficient self-hosted environment. AdGuard Home blocks ads and trackers at the DNS level, Traefik routes and secures web traffic, Cloudflare Tunnel exposes services safely without port forwarding, WireGuard enables secure remote network access, and Authelia adds authentication with multi-factor protection.
